title: SEC Regulation A+ Offering Tracker Input

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Free-text search across the filing (matches the issuer's name and filing text). Leave blank for all new Reg A+ offering statements market-wide.

includeAmendments.title: Include amendments (1-A/A)
includeAmendments.description: By default only original Form 1-A filings are returned (new Reg A+ offerings). Turn this on to also include 1-A/A amendments to already-filed offerings.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How many days back from today to search, by filing date.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of filings to return, most recently filed first.
